title: Split plugin crate into SDK, handler registry, filters, manifest, and sandbox capability modules
description: Prepare a Rust-native plugin SDK surface before adding real plugin loading, lifecycle, dashboard management, or sandbox execution.

files.change: Split command, permission, platform, event type, regex, and custom filters from registry code.
Define PluginContext, handler traits, lifecycle hooks, and testing harness entry points.
Define plugin permissions, sandbox profiles, and capability checks inspired by AstrBot tool execution.

criteria: SDK types are explicit Rust boundaries rather than crate-root growth.
Sandbox capability declarations are recorded before real plugin execution is expanded.
